description: Two independent eight step sequencers, each with per-step control voltage, four trigger and gate outputs and voltage control over length and direction; channel 1 also takes an input per step

params.text: Sends that step of channel 1 to TRIG A in its upper position or TRIG B in its lower position, with neither in the middle
Sends that step of channel 1 to TRIG C in its upper position or GATE D in its lower position, with neither in the middle
Sends that step of channel 2 to TRIG E in its upper position or TRIG F in its lower position, with neither in the middle
Sends that step of channel 2 to TRIG G in its upper position or GATE H in its lower position, with neither in the middle
Sets the voltage for that step of channel 1, 0V to 8V before the RANGE knob. It feeds CV 1 directly, and sets how much of that step's input voltage reaches CV 2
Sets the voltage for that step on the CV 3 output, 0V to 8V before the CV 3 SCALE switch is applied
Sets the voltage for that step on the CV 4 output, 0V to 8V before the CV 4 SCALE switch is applied
Sets how many of the eight steps that channel plays, from 1 to 8. The small green lights mark the steps that fall within that length
Latches on to silence TRIG A and TRIG C together, holding both at 0V while the light is lit
Latches on to silence TRIG B and GATE D together, holding both at 0V while the light is lit
Latches on to silence TRIG E and TRIG G together, holding both at 0V while the light is lit
Latches on to silence TRIG F and GATE H together, holding both at 0V while the light is lit
Scales CV 1 and CV 2 together, from nothing at one end of its travel to the full eight volt range of the channel 1 step knobs at the other
Sets the range of the CV 3 output to 2V, 4V or 8V, a CV 3 step knob at its maximum giving that voltage
Sets the range of the CV 4 output to 2V, 4V or 8V, a CV 4 step knob at its maximum giving that voltage
Picks forward, where the sequence runs left to right and starts over on the left; pendulum, where it runs out and back; or reverse, where it runs right to left

inputs.text: A high gate runs channel 1 and a low gate pauses it, picking up again at the next clock; with nothing patched channel 1 runs. 2V starts it, 0.1V stops it
A high gate runs channel 2 and a low gate pauses it, picking up again at the next clock; with nothing patched here channel 2 takes the channel 1 run input
A rising edge moves channel 1 on one step, and the time the clock spends high sets how long that channel's trigger outputs stay high
A rising edge moves channel 2 on one step; with nothing patched here channel 2 takes the channel 1 clock input
A rising edge restarts channel 1 at step one on the next clock; when reset and clock arrive within 100 microseconds of each other it moves to step one at once
A rising edge restarts channel 2 at step one on the next clock; with nothing patched here channel 2 takes the channel 1 reset input
Sets that channel's sequence length from the applied voltage and takes its LENGTH knob out of circuit while a cable is patched; 10V gives all eight steps. The two channels are separate here
An external voltage for step 1 of channel 1, reaching CV 2 attenuated by that step's knob. A polyphonic cable here spreads its channels across the step inputs left unpatched
An external voltage for that step of channel 1, reaching CV 2 attenuated by that step's knob; with nothing patched, CV 2 carries the same voltage as CV 1 for that step
Sets that channel's play direction and takes its direction switch out of circuit: under 2V forward, 2V to 4V pendulum, over 4V reverse. The two channels are separate here

outputs.text: Goes to 10V on a channel 1 step switched to A, for as long as the clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V on a channel 1 step switched to B, for as long as the clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V on a channel 2 step switched to E, for as long as the clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V on a channel 2 step switched to F, for as long as the clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V on a channel 1 step switched to C, for as long as the clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V for the whole of any channel 1 step switched to D; two neighbouring steps switched to D give a single gate lasting across both
Goes to 10V on a channel 2 step switched to G, for as long as the clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V for the whole of any channel 2 step switched to H; two neighbouring steps switched to H give a single gate lasting across both
The channel 1 step knob voltage for the current step, scaled by the RANGE knob. It changes on every step whether or not that step has a trigger or gate switched on
The voltage patched into the current step of channel 1, attenuated by that step's knob and by the RANGE knob; with nothing patched it carries the same voltage as CV 1
The CV 3 knob voltage for the current step of channel 2, scaled by the CV 3 SCALE switch
The CV 4 knob voltage for the current step of channel 2, scaled by the CV 4 SCALE switch
The channel 1 step knob voltage for the current step, scaled by the RANGE knob and then negated
The voltage on CV 2 negated, so a positive step voltage leaves here as a negative one
The CV 3 knob voltage for the current step of channel 2, scaled by the CV 3 SCALE switch and then negated
The CV 4 knob voltage for the current step of channel 2, scaled by the CV 4 SCALE switch and then negated

notes: SX-CV8, SX-OUT8 and SX-TRIG8 add further channels of output when placed immediately to the right, and the context menu will add a compatible expander for you
menu: Channel 1 — the Initialize and Randomize entries for channel 1, each offering Entire Channel, CV Only or Gates/Triggers Only
Channel 2 — the Initialize and Randomize entries for channel 2, each offering Entire Channel, CV Only or Gates/Triggers Only
Add CV expander — places a Sequencer CV Expander to the right of this module
Add output expander — places a Sequencer Output Expander to the right of this module
Add trigger expander — places a Sequencer Trigger Expander to the right of this module
Add random melody expander — places a Gated Comparator Random Melody expander to the right of this module
Add logic expander — places a Gated Comparator Gate Logic expander to the right of this module
